description: Gamma is an AI content creation platform for building presentations, documents, webpages, social posts, and related assets. It also provides workspace search, editing, export, comments, and engagement analytics for Gamma content.
summary: Gamma exposes a REST API at `public-api.gamma.app/v1.0` authenticated by either an API key or OAuth 2.0 bearer token, plus a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp.gamma.app/mcp` over streamable HTTP.
